title_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 11)
description_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 11), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This lecture continues the critique of doctrines that attribute limits and corporeality to the Creator.
